x01-sofia-shoes.note: Usable: several red shoes, clearly more than one, so them and not it; the blurred shoppers far behind carry no meaning.

x02-ana-eggs.observed_description: Ana (long dark wavy hair, sage-green overshirt over a white top) fries sunny-side-up eggs in a black pan on her stove, holding a spatula; separate round yolks are clearly visible.
x02-ana-eggs.note: Usable: several separate fried eggs, so She makes them is clearly plural; no other food.
